instruction: Run a speed test at speedtest.net and store the outcome in ~/Desktop/speedtest_results.txt.

metadata.explanation: Task requires running a speed test on speedtest.net and saving results to Desktop. The evaluator checks if speedtest_results.txt on Desktop contains the core metrics: Ping, Download, and Upload. This verifies the user completed the test and exported results to the correct location.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if all required keywords (Ping, Download, Upload) are present in the Desktop file, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements of the instruction: (1) file exists at the correct location (~/Desktop/speedtest_results.txt), and (2) file contains speed test results
The three keywords (Ping, Download, Upload) are semantically correct for verifying a speedtest.net result was saved
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the file from the VM at the expected Desktop location
Metric (file_contains) correctly implements the verification logic: checks all three keywords are present in the file text
Correct parameter handling: metric receives config={'expected': ['Ping', 'Download', 'Upload']} and correctly accesses config['expected'], following the framework's get_rule behavior for type='rule'
Complete instruction coverage: verifies both that the speed test was run (content check) and results were saved to the correct location (file path check)
Robust edge case handling: returns 0.0 for missing file, read errors, or missing keywords
No runtime issues: file-based verification, no UI/dialog state dependencies, no need for postconfig
